overrides.subtitle: B MINOR - HIGH VOICING
overrides.note: HIGH VOICING alternate: opt-in multi-voicing data, not a policy the engine reproduces (spec section 7).

overrides.subtitle: D MAJOR 7 (NO 5)
overrides.note: Hand-authored (NO 5) card outside the quality table (spec section 9).

overrides.subtitle: D MAJOR 7 SHARP 11 (NO 5)
overrides.note: Hand-authored (NO 5) card outside the quality table (spec section 9).

overrides.subtitle: F MINOR 9
overrides.note: Declared register exception (plan Premise 3, spec section 7); the engine also trims its own Fm9 at the 25-card cap (spec section 8).

overrides.subtitle: F MINOR 11
overrides.note: Extended tier: its 11th (Bb) is bottom-shell only, and an extended quality is a candidate only when every tone is on the TOP shell (spec section 8).

overrides.subtitle: Ab MAJOR - HIGH VOICING
overrides.note: HIGH VOICING alternate: opt-in multi-voicing data (spec section 7).

overrides.subtitle: Ab MAJOR 9
overrides.note: Extended tier: its 9th (Bb) is bottom-shell only (spec section 8, extended-only-on-the-top-shell).

overrides.subtitle: Bb MINOR 7 ( = Db6 )
overrides.note: Generated identically but trimmed by the 25-card cap: only 2 of its 4 tones are top-shell, so it ranks last among the sevenths (spec section 8).

overrides.subtitle: C MINOR - LOW VOICING
overrides.note: LOW VOICING alternate: opt-in multi-voicing data (spec section 7).

overrides.subtitle: C MINOR - HIGH VOICING
overrides.note: HIGH VOICING alternate: opt-in multi-voicing data (spec section 7).

overrides.subtitle: C MINOR 7
overrides.note: Generated identically but trimmed by the 25-card cap (spec section 8).

overrides.subtitle: Db MAJOR
overrides.note: Recorded D9 root-octave exception: the built-in roots on Db4 (U5), D9 takes the lowest instance overall, Db3 (U2) (spec section 7).

overrides.subtitle: Db MAJOR 7
overrides.note: Recorded D9 root-octave exception (spec section 7); the engine's Db3-rooted spelling is then trimmed by the cap (spec section 8).

overrides.subtitle: Eb MAJOR - LOW VOICING
overrides.note: LOW VOICING alternate: opt-in multi-voicing data (spec section 7).

overrides.subtitle: Eb DOMINANT 7
overrides.note: Recorded D9 root-octave exception - the built-in ships Eb3 although rim Eb4 exists (spec section 7); the engine's Eb4-rooted spelling is then trimmed by the cap (spec section 8).

overrides.subtitle: HALF-DIMINISHED
overrides.note: Generated identically but trimmed by the 25-card cap: 2 of its 4 tones are bottom-shell (spec section 8).
